newsArray.title: Sri Lanka's Captain Dhananjaya de Silva Supports Niroshan Dickwella Ahead of Test Series Against India
newsArray.description: As Sri Lanka gears up for the Test series against India, captain Dhananjaya de Silva has shown strong support for wicketkeeper Niroshan Dickwella, citing his exceptional glovework as a key reason for his selection. Dickwella returns to the Test squad after a significant absence, aiming to make a notable impact. De Silva also backs fast bowler Lahiru Kumara, despite his recent injury struggles. With both teams looking to improve their standings in the ICC World Test Championship, the upcoming matches promise to be competitive. newsArray.title: Jemimah Rodrigues Excluded from Key Tournaments Due to Injury
newsArray.description: Jemimah Rodrigues has been ruled out of the Women's Asia Cup and Asian Games due to a high-grade hamstring injury sustained during The Hundred tournament. The BCCI confirmed her injury, which will significantly affect India's preparations for these major T20 events. Pratika Rawal has been named as her replacement for the Asia Cup, which begins on August 28 in Dubai. India's women's team aims to defend their title at the Asian Games, where cricket will be played in T20 format from September 17 to October 3. The timeline for Rodrigues' recovery remains unspecified as she begins rehabilitation.
